# Continent 8 Technologies appoints Mike Small as CEO; Founder Michael Tobin transitions to Chairman

 3rd August 2026 

Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, today announced the appointment of Mike Small as Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. Founder Michael Tobin will transition to the role of Chairman following 28 years as CEO.

As Chief Executive Officer of Continent 8 Technologies, I have the privilege of leading a global organization that delivers secure, resilient, and highly available managed services, cloud, cybersecurity, connectivity, and infrastructure solutions for businesses operating in some of the world's most demanding and highly regulated industries. Our clients depend on technology that simply cannot fail. Our responsibility is to help them innovate with confidence, protect their critical operations, and build the digital foundations that power long-term growth. I'm particularly passionate about the role artificial intelligence will play in the future of business. AI is far more than another technology cycle—it represents a fundamental shift in how organizations operate, make decisions, serve customers, and empower employees. The companies that succeed will be those that combine innovation with responsible governance, resilient infrastructure, strong cybersecurity, and disciplined execution. The next decade will redefine how businesses operate. I believe secure digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, and the exceptional colleagues I work with at C8 will be at the center of that transformation.
